item.name: List issue occurrences for a run session

request.name: List issue occurrences for a run session

description.content:
List issue occurrences for a specific run session.

Gets occurrences through the RunSessionIssueMap table.

Args:
    workspace_name: The workspace name.
    runsession_id: The run session ID.
    session: Database session.
    current_user: The authenticated user.
    limit: Maximum number of results (default 100, max 250).
    offset: Number of results to skip.

Returns:
    Paginated list of issue occurrences with flattened issue attributes.
Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

item.name: List issue occurrences for a workspace

request.name: List issue occurrences for a workspace

description.content:
List issue occurrences at workspace level with optional date filtering.

Used by agentfarm to list issue occurrences between two timestamps.

Args:
    workspace_name: The workspace name.
    session: Database session.
    current_user: The authenticated user.
    observed_at_gte: Filter occurrences observed at or after this time.
    observed_at_lte: Filter occurrences observed at or before this time.
    limit: Maximum number of results (default 100, max 250).
    offset: Number of results to skip.

Returns:
    Paginated list of issue occurrences with workspace-level fields.

query.description: Filter occurrences observed at or after this datetime (ISO 8601)
Filter occurrences observed at or before this datetime (ISO 8601)

item.name: Get an issue occurrence by ID

request.name: Get an issue occurrence by ID

description.content:
Get a specific issue occurrence by ID.

Args:
    workspace_name: The workspace name.
    runsession_id: The run session ID.
    occurrence_id: The issue occurrence ID.
    session: Database session.
    current_user: The authenticated user.

Returns:
    The issue occurrence with flattened issue attributes.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if workspace, run session, or occurrence not found.
